hooks.name: UCDA-000001 Implementation Evidence Gate
hooks.description: Runs the UCDA-000001 Implementation Evidence Gate at session start, so the constitutional disposition state of every agreed decision (decision count, undispositioned count, conversation-only count, located evidence references, gate outcome, seal) is surfaced from Repository Truth rather than reconstructed from conversation. This is the executable expression of 00-CEP/CEP-002 Article 28 (CEP-002-AMD-002): no constitutionally agreed decision may remain only in conversation history. Deterministic, stdlib-only, non-blocking at session start; fail-closed as a gate. AUTHORITY = NONE (DERIVED TRUTH).
